verifyRegistration.subject: Verify your school registration on Classloom
verifyRegistration.heading: Verify your school registration
verifyRegistration.intro: Thanks for registering {schoolName} on Classloom. Confirm your email address with the button below.
verifyRegistration.linkFallback: Or open this link in your browser:
verifyRegistration.expiry: This link expires on {date} at {time} IST.
verifyRegistration.ignore: If you didn't register this school, you can ignore this email.

signInCode.subject: {code} is your Classloom sign-in code
signInCode.heading: Your sign-in code
signInCode.intro: Use this code to sign in to {schoolName} on Classloom.
signInCode.ignore: If you didn't try to sign in, you can ignore this email; your account is safe.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Classloom password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We got a request to reset the password of your Classloom account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email; your password hasn't changed.

newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your Classloom account
newDevice.heading: New sign-in to your account
newDevice.intro: Your Classloom account was just signed in to from a device we haven't seen before.
newDevice.warning: If this wasn't you, change your password and end the session from Security settings.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Classloom password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password of your Classloom account was just changed, and your trusted devices were reset.
passwordChanged.warning: If this wasn't you, reset your password now.

twoFactorResetByAdmin.subject: Your school turned off two-step sign-in
twoFactorResetByAdmin.heading: Your school turned off two-step sign-in
twoFactorResetByAdmin.intro: An admin at {school} turned off two-step sign-in for your Classloom account. Your recovery codes and trusted devices were removed, and you were signed out of every school.
twoFactorResetByAdmin.warning: If you weren't expecting this, tell your school admin. You can turn two-step sign-in back on in Security settings.

twoFactorChanged.warning: If this wasn't you, change your password and check Security settings.

enabled.subject: Two-step sign-in was turned on
enabled.heading: Two-step sign-in was turned on
enabled.intro: Two-step sign-in is now on for your Classloom account. You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in on a device we don't trust.

disabled.subject: Two-step sign-in was turned off
disabled.heading: Two-step sign-in was turned off
disabled.intro: Two-step sign-in is now off for your Classloom account. Your recovery codes and trusted devices were removed.

codesRegenerated.subject: New recovery codes were created
codesRegenerated.heading: New recovery codes were created
codesRegenerated.intro: New recovery codes were created for your Classloom account. Your old recovery codes no longer work.
